actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Aza makes two Beguiling Resonance attacks.

actions.name: Beguiling Resonance
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Aza casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|hypnotic pattern]]

bonus_actions.name: Enchanting Presence
bonus_actions.desc: Each creature within 30 feet of Aza must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the charmed condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to any muse's Enchanting Presence for 24 hours. Whenever Aza deals damage to the charmed creature, the charmed creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: Ebonclaw has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If Ebonclaw moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Ebonclaw can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

sb.name: Eyestalk of Gzemnid
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 9

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The eyestalk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eyestalk attacks with its bite and uses Eradication Gaze.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the eyestalk. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the eyestalk, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the eyestalk's turns. If the eyestalk takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the eyestalk must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the eyestalk. If the eyestalk dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Eradication Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The eyestalk creates an area of magical devastation in a 150-foot cone. Any creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine violet dust.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of its turns, Farrow can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Farrow deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Farrow that isn't incapacitated and Farrow doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Farrow makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: Gertrube has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Gertrube's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Gertrube makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The whirlwyrm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the whirlwyrm isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Thunder Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The whirlwyrm exhales a line of thunder that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The whirlwyrm makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the whirlwyrm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the whirlwyrm's turns. A whirlwyrm can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the whirlwyrm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the whirlwyrm must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the whirlwyrm. If the whirlwyrm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: Josbert has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Josbert's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Electrified Mancatcher
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grappled condition ends, the target has the restrained condition and can't teleport, Josbert can't make Electrified Mancatcher attacks, and the target takes 8 (1d10 + 3) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kal makes two Havoc Hammer or Havoc Flask attacks.

actions.name: Havoc Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. If the target is a creature, magical flames cling to it, causing it to take 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, the target can make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

actions.name: Havoc Flask
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d12) fire damage. If the target is a creature, magical flames cling to it, causing it to take 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, the target can make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a successful save. After Kal throws the flask, roll a d6; on a 3 or lower, Kal has no more flasks to throw.

sb.name: Kopoha
sb.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Kopoha fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Kopoha has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Kopoha's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Kopoha's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|greater restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]], [[Tools/Spells/Water Breathing|water breathing]], [[Tools/Spells/Water Walk|water walk]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|dispel evil and good]], [[Tools/Spells/Earthquake|earthquake]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Storm|fire storm]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only)

actions.name: Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +15 to hit, range 600 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (7d6) damage of one of the following types (empyrean's choice): acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant, or thunder.

legendary_actions.name: Bolster
legendary_actions.desc: Kopoha bolsters all nonhostile creatures within 120 feet of it until the end of its next turn. Bolstered creatures can't be charmed or frightened, and they gain advantage on ability checks and saving throws until the end of Kopoha's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Trembling Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kopoha strikes the ground with its maul, triggering an earth tremor. All other creatures on the ground within 60 feet of Kopoha must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Modron Planar Incarnate
sb.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison, radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the incarnate fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The incarnate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The incarnate deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The incarnate makes two Slam or Energy Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) force damage.

actions.name: Energy Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d12) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Planar Exhalation (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The incarnate exhales concentrated energy native to its plane in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 52 (8d12) necrotic damage, and the creature has the blinded condition until the end of the incarnate's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

reactions.desc: The incarnate can take up to three reactions per round but only one per turn.

reactions.name: Searing Gaze
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by an attack roll, the incarnate turns its magical gaze toward one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself and commands it to combust. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or take 16 (3d10) fire damage.

reactions.name: Teleport
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature the incarnate sees ends its turn, the incarnate teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If Ophelia moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Ophelia can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: Parvaz has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Parvaz makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.desc: R04M can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.desc: If R04M dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind its weapons and anything else it was carrying.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

sb.name: Shariel
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: Shariel's weapon attacks are magical. When Shariel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Shariel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Shariel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). Shariel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Shariel makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.desc: Shariel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Shariel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Shariel's choice). In a new form, Shariel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The impersonator can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the impersonator has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the impersonator surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The impersonator makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The impersonator magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the impersonator can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the impersonator's concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the impersonator has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The whirlwyrm can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The whirlwyrm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the whirlwyrm can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the whirlwyrm. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.desc: X01 can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Combat Ready
traits.desc: X01 has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.desc: If X01 dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was carrying.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If X01 fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: X01 makes one Pincer attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, X01 can't use this tentacle against other targets. X01 has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
X01 casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mending|mending]] (as an action)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Evil And Good|protection from evil and good]]

reactions.desc: X01 can take up to three reactions per round but only one per turn.

reactions.name: Counter Magic
reactions.desc: X01 attempts to interrupt a creature it can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, X01 makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

reactions.name: Lightning Rebuke
reactions.desc: When a creature within 120 feet of X01 damages it, X01 magically retaliates with an arc of lightning. The creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Psychic Defense
traits.desc: While Zaythir is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zaythir makes three Unarmed Strike or Psychic Bolt attacks. It can replace any of these attacks with one use of its Pacifying Touch.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Psychic Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Pacifying Touch
actions.desc: Zaythir touches one creature it can see within 5 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, or Zaythir chooses an action for that target: Attack, Cast a Spell, or Dash. The affected target can't take that action for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a successful save. A target that succeeds on the saving throw becomes immune to this githzerai's Pacifying Touch for 24 hours.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
Zaythir casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]] (the hand is invisible), [[Tools/Spells/See Invisibility|see invisibility]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]] (self only), [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]]
